title: Double Pendulum Mechanics
subtitle: Lagrangian Mechanics & Chaotic Phase Space Orbit
description: Rigorous classical mechanics simulation of coupled dual pendulums governed by Euler-Lagrange equations. Features real-time chaotic trajectory ribbon tracing, total mechanical energy tracking, and a live Phase Space (θ₁, dθ₁/dt) orbit inset.
